method: Read-only visual inspection of nine original native CI screenshots. No game, model, clock or report changes; no browser/native rerun. PNG bytes independently match the original per-mode report SHA256 and size.
result: No blocking visual issue observed in these nine original menu/driving/pause images. Full driving body is restored in all three observed modes.

images.viewedWith: view_image, one original image per call
findings: Original title, highlighted NEW GAME and SETTINGS controls are legible.
The display vehicle has a visible full body, wheels, turret and authored reflection.
Full controller card exposes the complete wrapping ID and actual TCP port; no title menu control is covered.

images.viewedWith: view_image, one original image per call
findings: The red player vehicle has a visible complete rear body and roof/turret; no missing-body visual-spring defect is visible in this captured frame.
Original road, minimap, standings, gear/speed/armour and weapon HUD are visible.
Compact controller identity card stays right of the player/HUD and below the standings without overlapping those controls.

images.viewedWith: view_image, one original image per call
findings: The four original centered pause controls (RESUME, RESTART, SETTINGS, QUIT TO GARAGE) are visible and the selected control is legible.
The full controller card is at the upper right and does not overlap the pause buttons.
The background is intentionally dimmed. The card overlays part of the inactive standings, not the active pause controls.

limitations: These PNG dimensions are recorded as image pixels; no CSS viewport or display scale is inferred.
A screenshot confirms a captured frame, not full-race completion or a performance benchmark.
Actual verified runtime scope is ARM64 native, ARM64 with occupied preferred port, and x86_64 via Rosetta on the ARM runner. The original Intel-runner failure remains unverified and unchanged.
No physical ESP32/phone/television/Mac display test is claimed.
The original 9 checks per mode remain authoritative; this separate visual review does not reclassify other failed platform attempts.
